"Forgot previous chat during this conversation

 Main Kernel Source

https://github.com/AK-Papon/oneplus_sm8250/releases/tag/TP_KERNEL-05082013

Use this repository as the primary kernel source. Do not use sources or configurations from previous tasks.

Required Root and Kernel Integrations

1. BakaSU: \"BakaSU_v4.2.0-rc3_35257\"
2. SUSFS: Version \"v2.3.0\"
3. NoMount: Version \"v2.2.0\"

Requirements

- Integrate all three components directly into the kernel source wherever supported.
- Ensure all integrations are compatible with the SM8250 platform.
- Resolve compilation errors and integration conflicts.
- Preserve existing device drivers, kernel functionality, and hardware compatibility.
- Verify that BakaSU, SUSFS, and NoMount work correctly.
- Do not introduce unnecessary modifications or replace the primary kernel source.

Final Build

Provide a successfully compiled, flashable AnyKernel3 ZIP compatible with the OnePlus 8 (IN2015).
"
